_comment: Curated knowledge base. Key = CVE id (the resolver also matches GHSA/PYSEC aliases). Every vulnerable_funcs entry was read off the fix commit diff saved under backend/tracelock/data/fixes/<sha>.diff and every entry_api call path was checked in the source of the vulnerable release. Names are dotted by import name. Extra keys: fix_commits (all fix commits incl. backports), evidence (diff files), affected (from OSV). safe_usage 'missing_is_safe': true marks rules whose kwarg defaults to the safe value (verdict.py does not read it yet and treats a missing kwarg as unsafe).

CVE-2020-14343.notes: Fix a001f27 (5.4) moves the add_multi_constructor registrations for python/module:, python/object: and python/object/new: from FullConstructor to UnsafeConstructor, so in <=5.3.1 FullLoader builds arbitrary objects from those tags. The hunk header names construct_python_object_new but the change is the module-level registration. Reached via yaml.load/load_all with no Loader (defaults to FullLoader in 5.1-5.4, lib3/yaml/__init__.py:103-125 at 5.3), full_load*, unsafe_load*, and any Full/Unsafe/plain Loader class. safe_load and Safe/Base loaders never construct python/* tags. Previous curated sha a001f27...d32e did not exist (404); corrected from the OSV FIX reference.

CVE-2020-1747.notes: Fix 5080ba5 (PR #386, 5.3.1) makes FullConstructor.set_python_instance_state reject state keys matching ^extend$ and ^__.*__$ (new BaseConstructor.check_state_key). In 5.3 FullConstructor registers python/object/new, whose constructor construct_python_object_new -> construct_python_object_apply -> set_python_instance_state lets a document set 'extend' and run code under FullLoader. OSV also lists 0cedb2a (5.1 yaml.load deprecation warning), which is not this fix.

CVE-2024-22195.notes: Fix 7167953 (3.1.3) makes do_xmlattr raise ValueError for keys containing whitespace (attribute injection when user input is used as dict keys). Templates reach it through the filter name: FILTERS['xmlattr'] = do_xmlattr (src/jinja2/filters.py:1838 at 3.1.2), copied into every Environment via defaults.DEFAULT_FILTERS. 'jinja2.filters.FILTERS.xmlattr' stands for that registration so a `|xmlattr` in a template (recorded by app_graph as a string ref) is matched. Exploitable only when attacker-controlled data is used as keys.

CVE-2024-34064.notes: Fix 0668239 (3.1.4) widens the do_xmlattr key check from whitespace to [\s/>=] (incomplete fix of CVE-2024-22195). Same reachability as CVE-2024-22195: templates using |xmlattr with user-controlled keys.

CVE-2023-32681.notes: Fix 74ea7cf (2.31.0) stops rebuild_proxies adding Proxy-Authorization for https targets, where it leaked to the destination through the TLS tunnel on a redirect. At 2.30.0 rebuild_proxies is only called from resolve_redirects (sessions.py:245), which Session.send runs when allow_redirects is true (default for every method but head; api.py builds a Session per call). Exploitable only when proxies with credentials are configured (explicitly or via HTTPS_PROXY); static analysis cannot see the environment.

CVE-2024-35195.notes: Fix a58d7f2 (2.32.0, PR #6655) changes HTTPAdapter.send to pick the urllib3 pool with the request's verify setting (new _get_connection); get_connection(url, proxies) ignored verify, so after one verify=False request every later request on the same Session to that host skipped certificate checks. Needs a verify=False call on a reused Session; the entry list over-approximates to any Session use because safe_usage cannot express 'unsafe only if some call passes verify=False'.

CVE-2023-45803.notes: Fix (2.0.7 / 1.26.18 backport b594c5c) drops the body and content headers when a 303 redirect switches the method to GET, in the redirect branches of HTTPConnectionPool.urlopen and PoolManager.urlopen. Reached through PoolManager.request/urlopen and urllib3.request (2.x _DEFAULT_POOL) with redirect left on. requests calls urllib3 with redirect=False and follows redirects itself, so requests users are not affected through it; the transitive verdict stays UNCERTAIN on purpose.

CVE-2023-43804.notes: Fix (2.0.6 / 1.26.17 backport 0122035) adds Cookie to Retry.DEFAULT_REMOVE_HEADERS_ON_REDIRECT, the list PoolManager.urlopen strips on cross-host redirects (poolmanager.py:461-468 at 2.0.5). A Cookie header the app sets by hand leaks to the redirect target. Only PoolManager follows cross-host redirects; HTTPConnectionPool cannot. NOTE: urllib3 1.26.17 (the brief's seed pin) is the fixed release, not affected.

CVE-2023-50447.notes: Fix 45c726f (10.2.0) makes ImageMath.eval reject environment keys containing '__' or naming a builtin; before it, attacker-controlled keys in the environment (_dict/**kw) gave code execution through builtins.eval. Any ImageMath.eval call with a non-constant environment is the risk.

CVE-2022-22817.notes: Fix 8531b01 compiles the expression and rejects names not in the environment (except abs), and runs builtins.eval with restricted builtins; before it ImageMath.eval evaluated arbitrary expressions. NOTE: pillow 9.3.0 (the brief's seed pin) is not affected; OSV range ends at 9.0.1.

CVE-2023-25577.notes: Fix 517cac5 (2.2.3) adds max_form_parts (default 1000) and counts parts in MultipartDecoder.next_event, plumbed through MultiPartParser.parse, FormDataParser._parse_multipart and Request.make_form_data_parser. Unbounded parts = CPU/memory DoS. Apps reach it by reading request.form / .files / .values (properties, Request._load_form_data at wrappers/request.py:413-480 in 2.2.2) - attribute reads app_graph does not record as calls - so the Request class itself and flask.Flask (every Flask app parses forms through werkzeug) are listed so a direct werkzeug import never yields a false NOT_REACHABLE. Remove flask.Flask once verdict.py keeps the transitive reason when the package is also imported.

CVE-2024-34069.notes: Fix 3386395 (3.0.3) adds DebuggedApplication.trusted_hosts and check_host_trust() to debug_application (evalex), execute_command, display_console, pin_auth and log_pin_request; before it a page on another host could drive the debugger console of a developer's machine. Reached by wrapping an app in DebuggedApplication, run_simple(use_debugger=True) (serving.py:1067-1070 at 3.0.2) or flask's app.run(debug=...) which passes use_debugger=self.debug. Flask.run without debug= depends on FLASK_DEBUG/config, so a missing kwarg there is treated as unsafe.

CVE-2023-30861.notes: Fix (2.2.5 / 2.3.2) makes SecureCookieSessionInterface.save_session add 'Vary: Cookie' whenever it sets or deletes the cookie, not only when the session was accessed; a caching proxy could otherwise serve one user's refreshed permanent-session cookie to others. Flask.process_response calls save_session on every response (app.py:2344 at 2.2.4), so any Flask app executes it; exploitation also needs permanent sessions, SESSION_REFRESH_EACH_REQUEST and a caching proxy. NOTE: flask 2.2.5 (the brief's seed pin) is the fixed release.

CVE-2024-6345.notes: Fix 88807c7 (70.0.0, PR #4332) replaces os.system('git clone --quiet %s %s' % (url, filename)) and the hg/svn equivalents in PackageIndex._download_git/_download_hg/_download_svn with subprocess argument lists (new _download_vcs). URL -> shell command injection. Reached from PackageIndex.download -> _download_url (package_index.py:567-589 at 69.0.3), fetch_distribution and fetch (easy_install paths).

CVE-2022-29217.notes: Fix 9c52867 (2.4.0) makes HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key reject any PEM or SSH key (new utils.is_pem_format / is_ssh_key; the old blocklist missed formats such as ssh-ed25519 and EC PEM), and OKPAlgorithm.prepare_key type-check its key. decode -> PyJWS._verify_signature -> alg_obj.prepare_key (api_jws.py:236 at 2.3.0). Exploitable when decode accepts both HMAC and asymmetric algorithms (e.g. algorithms=jwt.algorithms.get_default_algorithms()) so a token signed with the public key as HMAC secret verifies.

CVE-2024-24762.notes: Fix 20f0ef6 (0.0.7) replaces the OPTION_RE regex loop in parse_options_header with email.message.Message parsing; the regex backtracks catastrophically on a crafted Content-Type (ReDoS). Callers at 0.0.6: create_form_parser (multipart.py:1824), FormParser's multipart callbacks (1694), parse_form. Starlette/FastAPI import parse_options_header for Request.form(); FastAPI File()/Form() parameters also parse forms but are parameter defaults, which app_graph does not visit.

CVE-2024-23334.notes: Fix 1c33594 (3.9.2, PR #8079) normalises the joined path before resolving it when follow_symlinks is True, in StaticResource._handle and url_for; before it '../' escaped the static root. Only static routes registered with follow_symlinks=True are affected (default False: web_urldispatcher.py:1114 at 3.9.1); web.static(prefix, path, **kw) forwards to router.add_static.

CVE-2024-21503.notes: Fix f000936 (24.3.0) removes FIRST_NON_WHITESPACE_RE from lines_with_leading_tabs_expanded (quadratic backtracking on docstrings with many leading tabs). Called by fix_docstring (strings.py:73) from LineGenerator docstring handling (linegen.py:455 at 23.12.1), i.e. any formatting of untrusted source.

CVE-2023-49083.notes: Fix f09c261 (41.0.6, PR #9926) returns [] from Backend._load_pkcs7_certificates when p7.d.sign is NULL instead of dereferencing it (crash/DoS on a PKCS7 blob without certificates). pkcs7.load_pem/load_der_pkcs7_certificates call backend.load_*_pkcs7_certificates -> _load_pkcs7_certificates (pkcs7.py:21-30, backend.py:1855-1883 at 41.0.5).

CVE-2024-34062.notes: Fix 4e613f8 (4.66.3) removes eval(typ + '("' + val + '")') from tqdm.cli.cast, which typed CLI arguments. cast is only called from tqdm.cli.main (cli.py:215 at 4.66.1), exposed as tqdm.main and `python -m tqdm`; progress bars (tqdm.tqdm, trange) never reach it.

CVE-2022-23491.notes: Data-only fix 9e9e840 (2022.12.07): removes the TrustCor RootCert CA-1, CA-2 and ECA-1 roots from certifi/cacert.pem; no Python function changes. certifi.where()/contents() hand that bundle to TLS clients (requests, urllib3, httpx), so the risk is trusting the distrusted CA wherever the bundle is used.

CVE-2023-37920.notes: Data-only fix 8fb96ed (2023.07.22): removes the e-Tugra roots (E-Tugra Certification Authority, Global Root CA RSA v3 and ECC v3) from cacert.pem. Reached through certifi.where()/contents().

CVE-2024-39689.notes: Data-only fix bd81538 (2024.07.04): removes the GLOBALTRUST 2020 root from cacert.pem. Reached through certifi.where()/contents().
